blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—With the death toll at 77 and eight other passengers still unaccounted for, the Philippine National Police (PNP) has backed a proposed inter-agency task force to investigate the circumstances behind the tragic MV June Aster ferry fire. The MV June Aster, operated by Atienza Interisland Ferries, was en route to Palawan from Manila when it caught fire on Sept. 9 before eventually running aground off Coron. There were 43 survivors. “We will provide the necessary forensic, investigative, and law enforcement support to help establish the facts and determine accountability, if warranted,” PNP chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said in a […]...
